presets.name: Standard
presets.desc: A gentle band-limited cloud of the last second under the dry playing, half wet
presets.notes: ZamGrains' Standard played the dry signal; re-authored by intent: grains from ~500 ms back, level matched to the source

presets.name: Hold chord
presets.desc: Silent until held: stomp freeze after a chord and it rings on as a grain field you solo over
presets.notes: Freeze on the footswitch. skip 70 % keeps the pick out: the hold is what rings after the last strum; press it a beat after the chord

presets.name: Hold over a cloud
presets.desc: The hold chord gesture with the live cloud running behind the playing until the stomp
presets.notes: The live cloud stops feeding while held and resumes on release

presets.name: Granular delay
presets.desc: Metronomic grains 400 ms back with feedback: smeared, darkened echoes of the line
presets.notes: Spray 0 and ratio 1: the coherent normalisation makes a clean delay; each pass through the cuts darkens it

presets.name: Shimmer cloud
presets.desc: An octave halo: grains an octave up or down climbing through the feedback, no fizz
presets.notes: Re-authored from ZamGrains' Shimmer cloud (which played the dry). Band-limited +12 grains in the loop stay clean as they climb

presets.name: Fifths halo
presets.desc: Grains in fifths and octaves around the note, fed back into a widening halo
presets.notes: Fifths are safe on any note of a key

presets.name: Chord cloud
presets.desc: One note becomes a major triad: grains on its root, third and fifth, spread wide
presets.notes: Relative to the played note: a colour, not a harmoniser (the third moves with every note)

presets.name: Reverse swells
presets.desc: Every grain backwards with a swelling envelope: half-second reverse blooms
presets.notes: The envelope is independent of the direction: skew +100 makes the classic reverse swell

presets.name: Stutter
presets.desc: Beat-repeat glitches: sixteenth slices of the last bar, flat grains on the grid, some skipped
presets.notes: Re-authored from ZamGrains' Stutter. Positions land on whole steps back; flat grains keep C1 edges

presets.name: Tape-stop repeats
presets.desc: Eighth-note repeats that sag an octave over each grain, like a tape stopping

presets.name: Strum chains
presets.desc: Your last four notes replayed in sixteenths, attack kept: a rhythmic chain of what you played
presets.notes: Grains start 5 ms before each note onset so they keep the pick

presets.name: Arp shards
presets.desc: Recent notes cycled in sixteenths, each shifted by a minor-pentatonic step and panned

presets.name: Repeat the last note
presets.desc: The last note you played repeats in eighths, fading through light feedback

presets.name: Phrase loop
presets.desc: The last bar loops behind you as a looping delay; freeze holds the bar
presets.notes: Contiguous slices crossfade amplitude-complementary: exact unity; the seams are looper crossfades

presets.name: Octave mosaic
presets.desc: Half a bar sliced in eight, each slice an octave up, down or home, a few left out

presets.name: Phrase shuffle
presets.desc: The last bar in sixteen slices, half of them shuffled and a quarter reversed
presets.notes: Shuffled and reversed slices meet with equal-power seams

presets.name: Glide loops
presets.desc: A 1.5 s loop in six slices, each gliding up an octave over its length

presets.name: Particle buzz
presets.desc: Tiny metronomic grains a fifth up: the grain rate itself sounds as a synth-like formant
presets.notes: A synchronous stream is a pitch (3 kHz grain rate here), on purpose

presets.name: Dust
presets.desc: Sparse percussive specks from anywhere in the last second, scattered across the field

presets.name: Time-stretch freeze
presets.desc: Freeze four seconds and scan through them at quarter speed: the phrase, stretched
presets.notes: Stomp Freeze (the footswitch gesture) to hold the last four seconds, then scan through them; Freeze is a gesture, never stored on

presets.name: Granular doubler
presets.desc: A close doubled part: grains 20 ms back, detuned and spread a little, for voice or keys

presets.name: Bass pad
presets.desc: A cloud over the bass with its lows kept dry and clean; freeze holds a note as a pad
presets.notes: The low end stays in the unity dry; freeze as a gesture
